calls.title: Mustapha Modaffar and James Shannon
calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook's new EMEA lead) spoke with Mustapha Modaffar and Alex Cote (data science team at Reach) about their use of GrowthBook for A/B testing, highlighting pain points like internal restructuring and impatient leadership that threaten renewal. They discussed features such as self-hosting and data sovereignty, which were key to their adoption. Next steps: James will introduce them to account manager Carrie to help engage senior stakeholders and improve retention chances.
